name: cpsam_v2
what: Cellpose-SAM, the cpsam_v2 weights: the stock generalist Cellpose model that Cellpose 4.2.x loads by default (its built-in names are cpsam_v2, cpdino, cpdino-vitb and cpsam). Not trained for this pack. The budding yeast pack runs it on one 2D plane of the transmitted channel (the projected recipe cells_spots), where each mask is a whole cell.
pixel_um_note: Cellpose-SAM runs at the image's own scale; no training pixel size applies. The pack expects pixels of 0.05 to 0.15 um.

base_model.name: none
base_model.note: a stock model, not a fine-tune

date_note: the last change of the Hugging Face repository commit below; Cellpose 4.2.0 (2026-06-11) made these weights its default

training.by: the Cellpose authors (Pachitariu, Rariden and Stringer)
training.data: the Cellpose-SAM training collection; YeaZ budding yeast images are part of it (sampled at 1 to 2 percent), so yeast scores of this model are not independent of YeaZ data
training.paper: Pachitariu M, Rariden M, Stringer C. Cellpose-SAM: superhuman generalization for cellular segmentation. bioRxiv (2025)

holdout_note: not measured for this pack yet: the pack is provisional (0.1.0) and its recipes are not validated
licence_note: Weights: BSD-3-Clause (Hugging Face mouseland/cellpose-sam). The Cellpose training data include CC BY-NC sets, so commercial use of the weights is an open question. The weights are never stored in the pack: germquant pack fetch-models adopts the copy in Cellpose's cache after a size and sha256 check, or downloads the pinned address.
